title: Prospective comparative evaluation of the effectiveness of oncological rehabilitation in patients with breast cancer
summary: The PoR study will test the effectiveness of oncological rehabilitation on quality of life and participation in work in patients with breast cancer who receive additional radiotherapy for early or locally advanced tumour stages. As it is not possible to allocate patients to rehabilitation or no rehabilitation by lottery, the study will be conducted as an observational study. Three web-based surveys of patients will take place shortly after radiotherapy, 6 and 12 months later. The study will fill a gap in our knowledge of whether oncological rehabilitation in breast cancer patients meets key endpoints.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Patient with breast cancer after adjuvant radiotherapy.
- Still in working life (≤ 63 years)
- Intended curative therapy
- Basically capable of rehabilitation
- Sufficiently proficient in the German language to complete the web-based questionnaires or technical requirements are available.
Exclusion criteria:
- Metastatic/palliative disease
- Tumour therapy other than endocrine or antibody therapy
- Psychological illness treated with medication
- Old-age or full EM pension
- housewife
- Incapacity to give informed consent: patient lacking capacity who is unable to understand the nature, significance and consequences of the study
